title: Resolve the requested presentation before composing
inputs: explicit user profile or known existing artifact profile
steps: Run layout list when choices are needed.
Run layout resolve --profile <id> for an explicit choice or --existing <id> to preserve the known profile.
If resolve returns selection-required, offer both layouts and wait for the user choice before new-document composition.
Record profile ID, content revision, template parameters and format independently.
outputs: selected layout or explicit selection-required state
stopWhen: A new document has no selected profile.
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
